panel.logoutBlockedBody: Logging out couldn't remove this device from the server, so it would be left registered there with no way to clean it up. You're still signed in. Check your connection and try again, or force log out anyway and leave the registration behind.
panel.logoutConfirm:
Log out “%s” from %s?

This disconnects, removes this device's registration on that server, and returns you to the server-address step where you can sign in again.
panel.logoutNeedSignIn: Your session expired. Please sign in again to finish logging out.
panel.logoutPartialFail: You've been logged out, but clearing some local data failed. You can finish setup again from the start.
panel.logoutRemoteLinger: You've been logged out on this device. The server couldn't be reached, so this device's registration may still exist there until it's cleaned up.

trust.changedBody:
The certificate presented by %s is DIFFERENT from the one you trusted before. This can mean the server was reinstalled — or that someone is intercepting your connection.

New fingerprint (SHA-256):
%s

Trust this new certificate and replace the saved one?
trust.firstBody:
The certificate for %s is self-signed and can't be checked against a public authority. Verify the fingerprint with your administrator before trusting it.

Fingerprint (SHA-256):
%s

Trust this certificate on this device?
